notes.title: Route 66: The Free Ride - Livestream #2
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

First of all thanks to all of you who have already tried and played our Demo. Your feedback is invaluable to us in further developing the title, our goal always was to deliver the best Route 66 driving experience for all of you and thanks to your suggestions we will be able to move forward with our development.

If you have not played yet, be sure to download our Demo before the end of Steam Next Fest and leave us suggestions either on Steam community or by filling the form provided at the end of the Demo.

Also remember to add our full game to your wishlist so that you don't miss any new info.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435900/Route_66_Simulator/

notes.title: Route 66 Simulator: The Free Ride - Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

Today we have a great information for you as our game Prologue is participating in a Steam Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325860/Route_66_Simulator_The_Free_Ride/

Starting today you will all be able to test Demo version of our Prologue to see all the improvements we have made since our last Demo earlier this year. 

We can't wait to hear your opinions, so be sure to leave us feedback in the Discussion Tab on Steam or by using the form provided at the end of the Demo.

We hope you will have a great time and that we will see you on the road.
Also remember to add our full version to your wishlist if you have not done so already

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435900/Route_66_Simulator/

See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: Route 66 Simulator - New Round of Playtests
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,


We know it has been quite some time since our last post, but we were hard at work working on gathering all your feedback from Demo and making sure each issue gets addressed.

We are also working on new maps and locations, so today we would like to showcase you another map from our game, which is full of canyons and hidden surprises. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/e3393cb87728689c5aac56d416eccf5563cff7e5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/2bff1e8415d055e24edd2e203570f9c65f573103.png[/img]

We have also added a player character inside a car, to make driving more realistic, you can see all these changes in the video below.

[previewyoutube=WJvODzE_S0s;full][/previewyoutube]

We also have one big announcement to make, on may 29th we will be starting a new round of Playtests for limited amount of players, so be sure to sign up as quick as you can, but remember that Playtests will take place on our main game, not on Prologue, so that you will be among the first to have a chance to see all the changes we made to the game, as well as our newest map.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/2c07dc6dc420957155e9f37a171507bc83a310a8.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435900/Route_66_Simulator/

That will be all for today, remember to add our game to your wishlists, so that you get informed about any news as soon as we post them.

See you soon,
Grande Games.
